meta.title: Codex authorization entry
meta.description: Start Harness built-in Codex authorization from model settings without another model session. Inherits built-in cancellation and saving semantics. Local macOS only; real integration unverified.

ui.title: OpenAI Codex authorization
ui.intro: Authorize in your system browser without calling a model. Credentials are saved in Harness shared storage; model configuration is unchanged.
ui.present: A credential record exists; validity has not been verified.
ui.override: This Provider configures apiKeyEnv, which takes precedence over OAuth. Reauthorization may not change the authentication used. Check the configuration yourself; this plugin does not change it.
ui.overrideUnknown: API key override status is unknown. Saving OAuth does not guarantee this Provider will use it.
ui.busy: Another page or built-in flow is authorizing. Wait for it to finish.
ui.unavailable: Built-in OAuth, writable credentials, or local macOS support is unavailable.
ui.bootstrap: The Codex entry has not connected to its model card. Refresh to retry. Only same-origin pages on local macOS are supported.
ui.limits: This is an entry to the built-in flow. Cancel, timeout, or disconnect only requests withdrawal; the underlying flow may still run or save. Avoid authorizing elsewhere at the same time. Saved does not mean connection verified.
ui.manual: If automatic callback has not completed, paste the final full callback address from your browser:
ui.privacy: Only localhost:1455/auth/callback with a matching state is accepted, not a bare code. Input goes transiently to the local Host, is cleared after submission, and is not written to chat or logs.
ui.phase_unknown: The request outcome is unknown. Refresh status or request cancellation; do not start another authorization yet.
ui.phase_waiting: Requested the system browser to open. Complete authorization there; no authorization link is displayed here.
ui.phase_saving: The built-in flow is processing authorization or saving. Wait for its outcome; this status cannot identify when saving starts.
ui.phase_saved: The built-in flow reports authorization saved. Connection is not verified.
ui.phase_saved-after-cancel: Despite cancellation, the built-in flow reported authorization saved. Connection is not verified.
ui.phase_cancel-requested: Cancellation requested. The flow may still clean up or save; authorization has not been revoked.
ui.phase_timeout-requested: Timed out and requested cancellation. Stopping or saving cannot be guaranteed.
ui.phase_disconnected: The page stopped responding; cancellation requested. Stopping or saving cannot be guaranteed.
ui.phase_failed: The authorization entry did not complete. See the safe diagnostic; original exceptions are not displayed.
ui.error_NETWORK: Cannot reach the entry. No automatic retry; an existing attempt will request cancellation after the disconnect deadline. Refresh status to check.
ui.error_NO_FLOW: Harness does not provide the Codex OAuth flow.
ui.error_ALREADY_IN_FLIGHT: Authorization is already running. Do not start another attempt.
ui.error_NOT_COMMITTED: The built-in flow did not confirm saving credentials. Success cannot be reported.
ui.error_UNAVAILABLE: Required services or writable credentials are unavailable.
ui.error_BAD_REQUEST: The request does not match the entry contract.
ui.error_FORBIDDEN: Security checks rejected the request, or another page owns this attempt.
ui.error_PROMPT_CHANGED: The flow withdrew this input or ended. Refresh status.
ui.error_CALLBACK_INVALID: The callback is incomplete, has an invalid origin, or its state does not match. It was not submitted.
ui.error_CALLBACK_HOST: Callback binding is not an allowed loopback address. Login was not started; the environment was not changed.
ui.error_OPEN_FAILED: Could not open the system browser. Withdrawal was requested.
ui.error_UNSUPPORTED_FLOW: The built-in interaction differs from the reviewed version; interaction has stopped.
ui.error_CLOSED: The plugin has been unloaded or is closing.
ui.error_AUTH_FAILED: Built-in authorization did not complete. Network, callback, authorization, or storage may be involved; this does not establish an expired account.
